description: This file defines an abstract class and helper object for handling REST protocol messages in Apache Spark, including JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, and message type inference.

classes.name: SubmitRestProtocolMessage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a message exchanged in Spark's REST application submission protocol, with JSON serialization, validation, and message type handling.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the message object to a JSON string after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the message, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Performs actual validation checks, such as ensuring 'action' is not null.

methods.name: assertFieldIsSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific field is set; throws exception if null.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Checks a condition; throws exception if false.
